items.text: Barbad Tehrani was killed at the age of 17 by officers in Salsabil Street, Tehran. His mother shared a video narrating his story and the economic conditions. She also reacted to Masoud Pezeshkian, accusing him of calling their children terrorists at the United Nations.
Heydar Qadrian, a citizen from Saqez, has been detained by security forces for four days. The location of his detention remains unknown. This report was published by Harana News Agency.

The Iranian national football team dropped one place to 23rd in the FIFA rankings after losses to Uzbekistan and Russia. Iran had been among the top 22 teams since June 2023, but recent defeats ended this streak. The team has lost 20 points in the FIFA rankings since the start of the 2026 World Cup.

A Flydubai flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv diverted to Tabuk airport in Saudi Arabia after sending emergency signals. A passenger reported a man attacked the pilot with a knife. Flydubai stated all passengers are safe and the situation is under control.

The United States has announced the withdrawal of its last military forces from Iraq. This military presence has continued intermittently since the 2003 invasion. The withdrawal may lead to increased influence of the Islamic Republic and its proxy groups in Iraq.

Amin Mirzazadeh won the first gold medal for Iranian Greco-Roman wrestling at the 2026 Asian Games in Nagoya by defeating Rafael Tsitsvashvili from Uzbekistan. Mohammad Javad Rezaei and Gholamreza Farkhi were eliminated in other weight categories. With this medal, Iran moved up to sixth place in the medal table.

Today, workers of the Hepco machinery company gathered in front of the Arak governor's office. They demanded the appointment of an efficient CEO to resolve the company's structural and managerial issues and to pay their wage claims. The gathering was held to express workers' protests.

Iranians residing in Madrid gathered in front of the Spanish Ministry of Foreign Affairs on October 7. They protested against executions in Iran. They also condemned the meeting between the Spanish Foreign Minister and the Iranian Foreign Minister at the United Nations.

The Prime Minister of Iraq announced that the country has entered a phase where it will take full responsibility for its security and stability. He emphasized that no weapons or forces outside the law and government institutions will be allowed. The end of the international coalition's mission does not mean the end of Iraq's fight against terrorism.

Iran International inquired with the UK Treasury about special licenses for some Iranian banks and Iran Air. The UK Treasury declined to confirm or deny the issuance of these licenses. This issue arose following the continued operation of some Iranian banks in the UK after sanctions.

The interrogation session of Ali Vasaghi and Siamak Mirzaei, Azerbaijani activists imprisoned in Ardabil prison, was held on Monday, 6 Mehr, via videoconference. The session was conducted by Branch 10 of the Ardabil Prosecutor's Office, where charges were read to them. They defended themselves during the session.

Denmark has intensified security checks on Iranian PhD students and researchers. Aarhus University has rejected 89 applicants from high-risk countries, including Iran, since 2024. This information was reported by Mehran Abbasian, a journalist from Iran International.

Yousef Tabatabainejad, the Friday prayer leader of Isfahan, stated that the devaluation of the national currency and inflation are natural consequences of war, citing Iraq's experience. He mentioned that targeting vital infrastructure has caused price increases. He also emphasized that the government has managed affairs well despite the full-scale war conditions.
A video shows military forces conducting an exercise in a boys' school in Tehran. This action intensified the security atmosphere in educational places. The video was released by state media.

Bijan Mortazavi, a pop singer and musician, announced his trip to Iran via an Instagram live video. He is at Imam Khomeini Airport in Tehran with his wife. His wife stated that they came to Iran to take care of some matters.

Bloomberg reported an increase in oil exports from Arab countries through the Strait of Hormuz and alternative routes. Their oil exports have reached about 80% of the pre-war level. This report was published by Maryam Rahmati from Iran International.

A Flydubai plane on the Tel Aviv route experienced a sharp altitude drop. This occurred while passengers were unaware of the situation inside the aircraft. The plane landed at Tabuk Airport in Saudi Arabia.

A citizen showed a video to Iran International where a banner titled "Credit is dead" was installed in a store. He expressed concern about the 260-toman dollar rate. The video reflects reactions to the current economic situation.

Syria has announced the arrest of a three-member cell affiliated with Hezbollah in Lebanon. These individuals are accused of attempting to deploy rocket launchers near the Israeli border. More details were provided by an Iran International reporter.

The price of sanitary pads has increased by 145% year-on-year. The average price of a large size pack has risen from about 50,000 tomans to 138,000 tomans. The rising costs have led some women to use cheaper alternatives, which may threaten their health.

The Sports Human Rights Organization announced that seven Iranian athletes are at risk of execution in the prisons of the Islamic Republic. Ali Pishevarzadeh and Maryam Hedavand are among those sentenced to death. Concerns have been raised about torture, forced confessions, and denial of access to a lawyer.

Protests over the housing crisis in Spain continue for the fifth consecutive day. Hundreds of protesters have gathered in Madrid and set up tents in the square. They are protesting against rising housing costs, forced evictions, and insufficient government measures.

Dariush Atashafroz, sentenced to death at age 17, is now facing execution after nearly 16 years in Sepidar prison in Ahvaz. The execution has been postponed due to efforts to gain the victim's family's consent. The victim's family has not agreed to forgiveness or reconciliation and insists on the execution of the retribution sentence.

A group of Iranians residing in Hanover held a gathering on the seventh of Mehr. The gathering was in protest against executions in Iran. They expressed their support for political prisoners and those sentenced to death.

The Israeli Prime Minister announced that on a flight from Dubai to Israel, one pilot attacked another with a knife intending to crash the plane. Passengers and crew managed to restrain the attacking pilot, and a replacement flight team took control of the aircraft. The attacking pilot was arrested, and Saudi authorities are interrogating him.

Amin Mirzazadeh won the 11th gold medal for Iran at the Nagoya Asian Games by defeating his Uzbek opponent in the 130 kg Greco-Roman wrestling final. Mohammad Javad Rezaei and Gholamreza Farkhi were eliminated in the first round after losing to Kazakh opponents. This report was prepared by Alireza Modiri from Iran International.

Iranian judokas started their competitions at the Nagoya Asian Games. Mahsa Shakibaei and Abolfazl Mahmoudi were eliminated after losing to their opponents. The report was provided by Mehdi Kazemi from Iran International.

Uzbekistan lost to Japan in the men's football semifinals at the Nagoya Asian Games in a penalty shootout. The match ended 1-1 after regular and extra time, and Japan won 9-8 on penalties. South Korea also advanced to the final by defeating China.

Mohsen Rezaee warned on social media about the consequences of hosting US and Israeli military bases in the region. He urged the UAE to stop fueling wars and baseless claims over Iranian islands. Iran's Foreign Ministry condemned Netanyahu's visit to the UAE and warned of its dangerous consequences.

A citizen criticized the high cost of medicine in a video sent to Iran International and expressed fatigue with the current situation. He hopes that whatever is going to happen will happen soon. The citizen called for relief from the current conditions.

The head of the traffic police in Khorasan Razavi stated that 78 to 80 percent of traffic accident fatalities in the province occur after the accident during transfer or treatment. He cited outdated emergency fleets, emergency service issues, urban traffic, and inadequate hospital infrastructure as main factors. The fatality rate in Khorasan Razavi is 8 to 10 percent higher than the national average.

On the eleventh day of the 2026 Asian Games in Nagoya, Iran reached sixth place in the medal table by winning a gold medal in Greco-Roman wrestling by Amin Mirzazadeh. China leads with 151 gold medals. Japan, South Korea, Uzbekistan, and Thailand follow in the rankings.

A video shows an anti-riot vehicle stationed in the yard of a girls' elementary school in the Baghmisheh neighborhood of Tabriz. This occurred on Wednesday, October 8. The video was released by Iran International.

A Middle East expert stated that the Arab countries of the Persian Gulf are dissatisfied with the US policy towards the Islamic Republic. He added that secret cooperation between Saudi Arabia and Israel is expanding. These countries view Israel as a power with shared interests in confronting the Islamic Republic.

Benjamin Netanyahu ordered increased security measures for Israeli and non-Israeli airlines following the Flydubai flight incident. A replacement Flydubai flight departed from Tabuk Airport in Saudi Arabia to Israel. The flight is expected to last about 45 minutes.

A citizen in Isfahan reported that government supporters are disturbing people's nighttime rest by creating noise pollution and shouting. He called the disturbing individuals irrational and rude. The citizen stated that their turn to protest will also come.

Benjamin Netanyahu, during an unannounced trip to the UAE, stated that Israel expects the Islamic Republic to launch an attack in the coming weeks. He also shared new information about Iran's nuclear program and recent activities at the Kooh Kalang Gazla site with the UAE president. This topic was a major part of the discussions between Netanyahu and Mohammed bin Zayed.

The Chief of Staff of the Army has asked the people of southern Iran to prevent the entry of American soldiers. A member of the Expediency Discernment Council claimed that trained armed forces have entered the country. Basij has formed new units called Janfadaiyan aimed at suppressing people's uprisings.

A Flydubai plane flying from Dubai to Tel Aviv made an emergency landing in Saudi Arabia due to a conflict between pilots. The Israeli Prime Minister stated that the co-pilot attacked the other pilot with a knife and tried to crash the plane. The co-pilot has been detained by Saudi authorities and investigations are ongoing.

A replacement Flydubai flight carrying about 180 mostly Israeli passengers landed at Ben Gurion Airport. This flight followed an emergency landing at Tabuk Airport in Saudi Arabia due to an incident inside the cockpit. Medical teams at Ben Gurion are on standby to assist passengers if needed.

Cryptocurrency exchanges in Iran have stopped Tether transactions from 9 PM to 9 AM. This restriction is in effect from October 8 to October 12, with a daily purchase limit of 2,000 Tether. The measure was taken due to the rapid increase in foreign currency prices and the fall of the rial's value.

Andy Burnham, the UK Prime Minister, stated there is strong evidence that the Iranian government was involved in the weekend incident at the RAF Fairford base. Five British men were arrested on suspicion of terrorism-related offenses. Police investigations into the incident are ongoing.

Videos received by Iran International on Wednesday, October 8, show severe flooding entering the streets of Aliabad Katoul in Golestan province. The flood has caused waterlogging in the area. Reports indicate flooding has occurred in this region.

The Minister of Culture has submitted a list of over 100 Iranian figures abroad to authorities for their return. The judiciary announced the seizure of assets and blocking of bank accounts of Iranian critics abroad. A system called "Elaj" has asked the public to report these individuals.

Videos released show that Amir Ghalenoei and his assistants fled from reporters upon arrival in Tehran after two friendly matches against Uzbekistan and Russia. Most national team players also refused to talk to the media.

Nasrin Sotoudeh discussed the experience of the One Million Signatures campaign and its role in changing perspectives on women's rights. She emphasized the importance of men's support and the unity of women with different beliefs. Sotoudeh also spoke about mandatory hijab, the Mahsa movement, and the future of women's demands.

Heavy rainfall on Wednesday, October 8, in Juybar, Mazandaran caused flooding in the streets. Firefighters and people used pumps and other equipment to drain the water. This incident was shared on social media.

Andy Burnham stated that strong evidence indicates the Islamic Republic of Iran was involved in the recent security incident near RAF Fairford. British counter-terrorism police arrested five young men on suspicion of preparing a terrorist act and later released them on bail. RAF Fairford is used to support US attacks against Iran.

Mark Rutte said the US targeted Iran's nuclear capability because Europe cannot do it. He added that Europe should independently gain this capability within 10 years. Europe should also be able to confront the Houthis without relying on the US.

Pep Guardiola supported Manchester City after the club was found guilty of violating Premier League financial regulations. He stated that he remains behind the club, its owner, and the fans. Guardiola was the team's coach for 10 years and has defended the club during previous crises.
A citizen from Bandar Abbas criticized the rising prices of food items. He said the inflation has made him tired of futile efforts and work. The video was sent to Iran International.

Georges Jesus, the coach of Portugal's national team, stated that there is no conflict between him and Cristiano Ronaldo. He admitted that Ronaldo was unhappy about being on the bench during the match against Norway. Jesus said Ronaldo will play in the next game against Denmark if needed.

The Financial Action Task Force warned Canada that despite its strong investigative capabilities, it faces serious challenges in prosecuting complex money laundering cases. The annual volume of dirty money in Canada is estimated at up to 113 billion dollars. The organization set a three-year deadline to enhance oversight and confiscate assets derived from money laundering.

Cristiano Ronaldo left the Portugal national team camp after the coach's comments about his absence in matches. The coach stated Ronaldo would not play against Denmark unless needed. Ronaldo left Parken Stadium in a federation van and is set to travel to Madrid.

Donald Trump announced that the last American forces are leaving Iraq and that the US presence there will soon become history. He described the decisions leading to US entry into Iraq as very bad and called Iraq a quagmire. Trump called this day a great day for America and praised the Iraqi Prime Minister.
Ali Jahaniyan, a political prisoner held in Malayer prison, was granted leave. This leave started on Wednesday, 8 Mehr, and will last for ten days. The news was reported by Harana News Agency.

A Flydubai flight with about 180 passengers, mostly Israeli, made an emergency landing in Saudi Arabia. The co-pilot allegedly tried to crash the plane after stabbing the captain. The suspect pilot, an Omani national, was arrested in Saudi Arabia and is being interrogated by Saudi authorities.

Donald Trump stated that the US has been at war with the Islamic Republic for six months and that Iran's military capability is completely destroyed. He said the US has almost full control over the Strait of Hormuz. Trump also described Iran's economic situation as poor with inflation exceeding 300 percent.

Some technical infrastructure workers eligible for early retirement have reported that their retirement process has been halted. The stoppage is due to several months of unpaid insurance premiums by the employer. This issue has caused difficulties for these workers' retirement.
A security incident occurred on a flight to Tel Aviv. The pilot of this flight has been arrested. A moment-by-moment report of the incident was provided by Niusha Saremi.

Gideon Sa'ar, Israel's foreign minister, spoke with Abdullah bin Zayed Al Nahyan, UAE's foreign minister. They emphasized strengthening relations and cooperation against extremist elements. They also discussed the return of Israeli passengers on the Flydubai flight.

Families and relatives of those killed in the December protests keep the memory alive with tattoos. Injured protesters use protest-related designs to cover their wounds. This topic was discussed in an interview with Azadeh Akbari.

Mehdi Mahdavi-Azad said that repeating claims about the arming of rioters and the danger of civil war is an effort to prepare public opinion for a possible crackdown on protesters. He added that the Islamic Republic previously used warnings about Syria-like conditions in Iran to scare people. Now, with harsher rhetoric, it aims to justify harsher actions against protesters.

Alireza Beiranvand commented on the national team's performance after returning to Iran. He said, "It is not over yet, one game remains." This ambiguous statement concerns the status of the national team.

The cost of education in Iranian schools has increased sharply. Prices of books, stationery, and tuition fees for public schools and vocational schools have reached very high amounts. Additionally, a student was expelled for tearing a picture of Khamenei.

The expulsion and two-semester suspension of Reza Niaparest, a master's student of history at Shahid Beheshti University, was confirmed by the university's appeals council. This ruling is final. Reza Niaparest is banned from continuing his studies.

A video released by state media shows the presence of military personnel in a boys' school in Eslamshahr. Forces affiliated with military institutions gave a speech and played religious-heroic songs loudly for the students. This event took place in an educational setting.

Four firefighters in Mahabad were injured due to unsafe working conditions and lack of safety measures. The incident occurred while they were on duty. More details are available from Harana news agency.

Donald Trump announced that new developments regarding Iran will happen "very soon." He said Iran is facing over 300% inflation and poor economic conditions. Trump also claimed that Iran's navy, air force, and air defense equipment have been destroyed.

A student reports financial difficulties in buying a laptop and high dental and medical costs for their child. The costs of living and language education are very high, and incomes do not cover expenses. People complain about the economic situation and severe inflation.

Kazem Alinejad, a political prisoner, is deprived of proper medical care in Evin prison due to multiple illnesses including diabetes and heart and lung problems. His physical condition has worsened in the past two weeks with chest pain and shortness of breath. His family is unable to obtain necessary medications due to his lack of hospital referral and medical prescription.

Mohammad Reza Naqdi said Trump is thinking about his own economic interests, not the national interests of the US. He added that five thousand American soldiers are stranded on aircraft carriers in the ocean, and US ships in the Indian Ocean have not been able to dock at the Fifth Fleet base. Naqdi also mentioned Iran's military budget and criticized the US government model.
The audio version of the program 24 with Fardad Farahzad has been released. The program discusses events on the Flydubai flight to Tel Aviv. It examines the near disaster on this flight.

A video of Ali Asghar Estakhr dancing, who was killed in the December 2025 protests, has been released on social media. His family rejected the proposal to list him as a martyr and supporter of the government. The video was published with music.

Ehsan Haddadi, head of the Athletics Federation, announced the return of two athletes and a coach to Iran. This return follows the implementation of a memorandum between Iran's Foreign Ministry and South Korea. The case involves allegations of group assault by four members of Iran's delegation at the 2025 Asian Championships in Gumi.
A video from Eslamshahr shows a military vehicle entering a girls' school. This video was received by Iran International. No further details about the incident have been reported.

A citizen reported that the price of a small cake increased by 10,000 tomans within one week. This was reported to Iran International via a video. The price increase in this time frame is significant.

Ehsan Hadadi announced an urgent meeting with runners who participated in the Asian Games. He warned athletes about choosing between virtual fame and real championship. It was also mentioned that some runners, like Farzaneh Fasihi, have been under pressure and several runners have migrated to the United States.

At the 81st UN General Assembly, about 34% of speeches addressed Iran or related crises. One out of every three speeches mentioned Iran in some way. This was observed even in speeches from countries that usually mention Iran less frequently.

A video showing the transport of a missile in the streets of Najafabad, Isfahan province, on Wednesday, October 8, has been released. The video was received by Iran International. The event took place on October 8.

Axios reported that mediators, especially Qatar, have not succeeded in bringing Tehran and Washington closer. There is a possibility of renewed US attacks. Donald Trump stated that the US has achieved a complete military victory in the war with Iran.

Donald Trump announced that more information about the release on bail of suspects in a possible conspiracy against a British airbase will be released by the end of the day. These individuals were detained on suspicion of involvement in the conspiracy. Reports indicate that American forces used this base to attack Iran.

Amir Ghalenoei, head coach of Iran's national football team, promised to rebuild the team even better than before. After two losses against Uzbekistan and Russia, he stated that weaknesses will be corrected and structural changes will be made if necessary. Ghalenoei emphasized that he accepts mistakes but will not give up, aiming for success in the Asian Cup.

Donald Trump stated that the US must decide between military action and reaching an agreement with the Islamic Republic. He mentioned the possibility of bombing Iran and said the issue will end soon. Trump also described Iran's military and economic situation as dire.

Christopher Behnam, a United Airlines pilot, explained the security incident on the Flydubai flight. He said if the captain had not opened the cockpit door, the attacking co-pilot could have taken control of the plane. The intervention of the crew and other pilots saved about 180 passengers' lives.

Flydubai announced it will suspend its flights to and from Israel until investigations into the recent incident are completed. This temporary suspension allows authorities to continue their investigations. The company stated it will review its decision after receiving more information.

Morad Veisi, senior analyst at Iran International, said that methods of overthrow can complement each other. He emphasized that overthrowing the Islamic Republic is a collective effort of the Iranian people. He stressed the importance of seriously considering combined methods to achieve this goal.

Mohammad Hafez Hakami, Deputy Minister of Communications, stated that Iran's governance over cyberspace is now based on Starlink and there is no clear policy to counter it. He warned that if Starlink becomes widespread, the country's governance over cyberspace will be lost. He also mentioned that out of about 13,000 Starlink satellites, 1,600 are non-functional, which is more than the total satellites of China, Russia, India, and Europe.

The Iranian Human Rights Documentation Center reported on the inefficiency of debtor imprisonment laws in Iran's judicial system. According to the report, individuals unable to pay debts are sometimes imprisoned and must prove poverty or pay debts to be released. The center's director called for the abolition of debtor imprisonment and the implementation of mechanisms to assess individuals' financial capacity.

Donald Trump, President of the United States, said the Islamic Republic lost 4,500 people in the recent war, while according to him US casualties were 18. He added that events will happen "very soon." Trump also said Iran's economy has been destroyed, inflation has reached over 300 percent, and the Islamic Republic's navy, air force, and defense equipment have been destroyed.

Morad Vaisi, senior analyst at Iran International, called for the participation of people inside and outside Iran in overthrowing the Islamic Republic. He said everyone should use the tools they have to chip away at the wall of tyranny until it collapses.

Benjamin Netanyahu spoke with Mohammed bin Zayed after the Dubai to Tel Aviv flight incident. He described the event as terrorist and said the pilot intended to bring down the plane. Netanyahu also plans to discuss the matter with Donald Trump.

Ivar Farhadi stated that security cooperation between Israel, the UAE, and Saudi Arabia has begun and may expand with ongoing tensions from the Islamic Republic. The Islamic Republic faces a choice between continued economic pressure or broad retreat. There is a possibility of escalating confrontation in the Persian Gulf.

Max Meizlish, a researcher at the Foundation for Defense of Democracies, told Iran International that the Islamic Republic extensively uses cryptocurrencies, especially dollar-backed stablecoins, to sell sanctioned oil and buy dual-use equipment from China.

The Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps wrote a letter to the American people warning about the country's economic collapse. The letter urges American voters to overthrow the Trump administration. It is both an invitation to friendship and an electoral recommendation.

The US Central Command announced that it has changed the routes of 125 commercial ships by Wednesday to enforce the maritime blockade of the Islamic Republic. Previously, the routes of 122 commercial ships had been changed. These actions are part of the maritime blockade enforcement.

US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth stated that the US and its allies have destroyed Iran's navy, air force, defense systems, leadership, and military industry. He said Iran's conventional shield and nuclear targets have been paralyzed. He added that US forces will ensure Iran never acquires nuclear weapons.

The office of Prince Reza Pahlavi warned about fake emails titled "Iran in 2035." These emails falsely claim to represent Reza Pahlavi. The office urged recipients not to respond or click on links in these emails.

The police of Sistan and Baluchestan announced that Alireza Sancholi, a law enforcement officer, was killed in an armed attack on the Ahmadabad checkpoint in Rask. The police are working to identify and arrest the attackers. The deputy governor of Sistan and Baluchestan had previously stated that the attack caused no damage.

US Secretary of State Marco Rubio ordered the Iranian delegation accompanying Abbas Araghchi to immediately leave New York after negotiations with the Islamic Republic reached a deadlock. The delegation flew from New York to Doha at 1:20 AM on Tuesday. This action followed the failure of Qatari mediators to achieve a breakthrough in Washington-Tehran talks.

Marco Rubio, the US Secretary of State, ordered the immediate exit of the Islamic Republic's delegation from the US. This decision was made after failed negotiations and a deadlock in Qatar's mediation. The US believes Iran no longer has effective control over the Strait of Hormuz, and Iranian oil exports have dropped to nearly zero due to the US naval blockade.

The Israeli Prime Minister said it is still early to identify the perpetrator behind the foiled attempt to bring down the Flydubai flight. The suspected co-pilot is under interrogation in Saudi Arabia and may be transferred to the UAE. Israel may participate in the investigation of the incident.

Benjamin Netanyahu said in a Fox News interview that Israel had provided intelligence to Britain showing an attack supported by the Islamic Republic was being planned. According to him, London sanctioned Israel 'almost the next day.'

Donald Trump shared a New York Post report about Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent's statement that Iran's economy will have 'nothing to trade' within two weeks. Bessent said the naval blockade has prevented Iran from exporting oil and that the US dollar has hit new highs. He claimed Iran is desperate for a deal due to economic collapse and warned that problems will worsen dramatically in the next two weeks.

Marco Rubio ordered the Iranian delegation at the UN General Assembly to leave the US after negotiations with Iran reached a deadlock. The US mission at the UN informed the Iranian delegation that they must immediately leave New York. Iraqchi and the delegation members went to the airport a few hours later and flew to Doha.

In a speech to US Marines, Pete Hegseth called the leaking of classified information by media “treason,” saying it has endangered American forces. He also announced the creation of an autonomous warfare command with Elon Musk and a nationwide competition to host the next US base.

Russia launched a new wave of air attacks targeting Kyiv and several regions of Ukraine with nearly 190 drones and several ballistic missiles. Ukraine's energy infrastructure was a primary target in these attacks. This report was provided by Lily Nikfar, a journalist from Iran International.

Ghassan Ashour said that the withdrawal of US military forces from Iraq will not cause a major field change as these forces were mostly stationed in their bases. He added that groups close to the Islamic Republic have new excuses to avoid disarmament. These groups prioritize Tehran's interests over Iraq's interests.

Donald Trump reshared a New York Post report about economic pressures on the Islamic Republic. The report quotes Scott Bassett saying that within two weeks, there might be nothing left of Iran's economy. Bassett also stated that after delivering the last oil shipments to China, Iran will have nothing left to trade.

Associated Press reported that the Iranian rial has reached its lowest historical value. Food and medicine prices have increased, and oil export restrictions have added more economic pressure. This report was prepared by Maryam Rahmati from Iran International.

Amir Hamidi stated that Donald Trump's remarks about the possibility of continued military actions should be seen within the framework of diplomacy with pressure. He added that Washington and Tehran still have fundamental disagreements on key issues. Two paths lie ahead: a feasible agreement or increased risk of conflict escalation.

Mohammad Qaedi said Saudi Arabia has distinguished between its political stance towards Israel and humanitarian aid to passengers. He added that such cooperation could strengthen security ties between Saudi Arabia and Israel. Also, if the incident's connection to Tehran is confirmed, pressure on the Islamic Republic will increase.

Andy Burnham, the British Prime Minister, stated there is strong evidence that the Islamic Republic was involved in the attack on the RAF Fairford base. Benjamin Netanyahu said Israel provided intelligence to Britain warning of the attack. According to Netanyahu, the attack was supported by the Islamic Republic.

Kataib Hezbollah announced that it will stop its military activities following the withdrawal of American forces from Iraq. The group exempted hostile aircraft from this decision. This stance was declared after the last American forces left Iraq.

About 20 Iranian tankers have been stranded 15 miles off the southwest coast of Sri Lanka, with their food, fuel, and fresh water supplies running low. These tankers have been stuck near Sri Lanka and Malaysia since July. The US has asked Sri Lanka to prevent services to these tankers.

Ali Madanizadeh, the Minister of Economy, rejected Scott Bassett's claims about the collapse of Iran's economy, stating these claims aim to create unrest and increase currency prices. He added that war damages to small and medium units have been compensated. Part of the financial issues is related to a currency attack acknowledged by the US and Israel.

Kambiz Tavana referred to his conversation with Max Mizlish, who said cryptocurrencies could act as a backdoor to bypass US financial sanctions. Mizlish believes the Islamic Republic might conduct transactions initially unnoticed by US agencies. However, there is an ongoing process to monitor and block these identified activities.

Mohammad Mokhber called Donald Trump's statements baseless and said these remarks will fail as before. He described national unity as a strength of the Islamic Republic. He also emphasized that the fighters continue their path relying on God and the support of the people.

Davood Sajadi warned about the importance of Starlink and users' ability to bypass government filters. He said the government cannot fully block access to Starlink and has disrupted GPS signals. This issue has caused concern among government agents.

Hossein Ghazian stated that Iran is on the path to an aging population and the concerns of Islamic Republic officials have a promotional aspect. He said the proportion of the economically active population is decreasing and the 'golden population window' opportunity has been missed. Ghazian warned that the aging population could become a social burden.

North Korea has established a secret detention center in the basement of its embassy in Beijing for suspects attempting to escape. Individuals are held and interrogated there without formal legal procedures before being returned to North Korea. This report comes from a Seoul-based human rights organization and a former Pyongyang diplomat.

Hadi Norouzi, former captain of Persepolis, passed away 11 years ago on Mehr 9, 1394 due to cardiac arrest. He achieved one runner-up in the Premier League and two Hazfi Cup championships with Persepolis. Persepolis fans call his name at the 24th minute of matches to honor his memory.

Mohammad Mohahed stated that the US has moved beyond traditional sanctions to an operational siege against the Islamic Republic. The US aims to prevent any country from interacting with Iran and has targeted regional trade hubs. Washington's goal is to block Iran's vital communication and financial channels.

The Israeli army announced that its air force targeted more than 500 sites in southern Lebanon and the Gaza Strip over the past month. Over 370 Hezbollah targets in southern Lebanon and more than 140 targets in Gaza were attacked. These attacks included targeting Hamas commanders and weapons depots.

Asad Halfi, a 37-year-old resident of Ahvaz, was arrested six days ago by the Intelligence Forces of the IRGC. His place of detention remains unknown. During the arrest, his home was searched and some of his personal belongings were confiscated.

Rouhollah Rahimpour said the Islamic Republic was creating a narrative of victory from negotiations that essentially did not happen. He added that the possibility of renewed conflict between the US and the Islamic Republic is real and serious. The White House has not yet made a final decision to start the conflict.

A man in a village near Marand killed four members of his wife's family due to family disputes using a firearm. This incident occurred in a village near Marand. Further details have not been released.

US aviation sanctions against Iran have disrupted some Iranian airlines' operations in Turkey. The suspension of certain routes and flight disruptions have created uncertainty for Iranian travelers. This report is provided by Farzia Sabti from Iran International.

At the same time as Iranian wrestlers competed on the twelfth day of the Nagoya Asian Games, some opponents of the Islamic Republic held a protest gathering in front of the Inai Sports Hall. This report was provided by Alireza Modiri, a journalist from Iran International.

Alma Aveiro, Cristiano Ronaldo's sister, defended her brother on Instagram and criticized the structure of Portugal's national team and its media. Ronaldo sat on the bench during Portugal's match against Norway and left the national team camp after the press conference. These statements added uncertainty about Ronaldo's future in the national team.

Pakistani fighter jets conducted targeted airstrikes in the Kunar and Helmand provinces of Afghanistan early Thursday. Pakistan's Ministry of Information reported 22 killed and large amounts of weapons destroyed in these attacks. Taliban sources confirmed civilian casualties in the strikes.

Majid Sharifi, a Sunni citizen, was transferred from the Intelligence Detention Center to Sheiban Prison in Ahvaz on Monday, October 6. He remains in detention, and his family has not yet been able to visit him. This news was reported by HRANA news agency.

Hossein Taeb, head of the Basij organization, stated on the occasion of Police Week that enemies are targeting the country's security and unity using new hybrid warfare methods. He emphasized the need for vigilance, solidarity, and cooperation among responsible agencies and the public. He also highlighted that sustainable security depends on the strong presence of law enforcement forces and strengthening the bond between society and security defenders.

The Iranian mission to the UN denied Axios's report about Marco Rubio's order for the immediate departure of Abbas Araghchi and his delegation from New York. The mission stated that the Iranian delegation left New York according to a prearranged schedule. The US State Department was informed of the departure plan in advance.

A man in Tehran set fire to his mother-in-law's house and killed her after his wife decided to separate. The perpetrator died in the fire, and four others, including his wife, were injured. This incident occurred yesterday.

The friendly match between Iran and Guinea-Bissau scheduled for October 6 was canceled due to organizational issues. The Football Federation is seeking another opponent for the third preparatory match. Negotiations with several other federations also failed.

Etihad Airways is considering legal action against the English Premier League following the independent commission's ruling on Manchester City's financial violations. The company denied any involvement in illegal commercial agreements. Etihad Airways criticized the Premier League's way of communicating the ruling.

Tayebeh Mahroozadeh stated that Mojtaba Khamenei was present and in good health during the burial of Ali Khamenei. She also mentioned seeing him that night and confirmed his good health. However, no images of Mojtaba Khamenei at the ceremony have been released.

Mehdi Fazeli stated that the armed forces are prepared for all scenarios, including a war of attrition and lightning operations. He said the military capability of the Islamic Republic has significantly increased since March 1. Additionally, tests have been conducted where missiles exploded near American ships, serving as a clear warning to the US.

Alireza Abdoli won the gold medal in the 77 kg Greco-Roman wrestling final at the Nagoya Asian Games by defeating Kosaka from Japan 5-3. He advanced to the final with decisive victories in earlier rounds. This was Iran's twelfth gold medal in the Games.

Reuters reported that the supply of fuel oil at Fujairah port in the UAE has increased in recent months, allowing the port to resume bunkering and boost exports to Asia. Fujairah had faced a sharp decline in sales in the second quarter after the war began and disrupted fuel supplies. With the increased supply, the UAE has once again become the largest fuel oil exporter in the Middle East, although marine fuel sales and Fujairah's fuel oil inventories remain below pre-war levels.

Contrary to Iran's international commitments under the Convention on the Rights of the Child, 200 students from Maku were sent to war zones. This deployment was part of a camp called 'Rahian-e Noor'. This action violates the clause prohibiting the use of children in military activities.

The Japanese foreign minister called Abbas Araghchi, urging Tehran to show maximum flexibility in negotiations with the US. Japan emphasizes reducing tensions and strengthening diplomacy. Both sides agreed to maintain close communication for a diplomatic solution.

Mehdi Bali won the bronze medal in the 97 kg Greco-Roman wrestling category at the 2026 Nagoya Asian Games by technical fall against Uluyf from Kazakhstan. He defeated opponents from Saudi Arabia and Kyrgyzstan in earlier rounds and lost to Yuri Nakazato from Japan in the semifinals.
